summary: Russian forces launched a massive combined missile and drone barrage targeting Kyiv region and multiple Ukrainian oblasts, with ballistic missiles from Chernihiv region striking near Boyarka and Brovary while Shahed drones entered from Bryansk region and Black Sea. Ukrainian air defense engaged targets across northern, central, and southern regions, and Russian ground forces advanced near Bochkove and Kotlyne in Donetsk region. Simultaneously, Russian strikes hit a passenger train in Kharkiv region, a business center in Odesa with double-tap tactics, and an apartment building in Sumy.
key_points: Russian ballistic missiles launched from Chernihiv region struck Kyiv region including Brovary district and Boyarka area. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75117, @mon1tor_ua/75114, @mon1tor_ua/75115)
Multiple Shahed-type drones entered Ukrainian airspace from Bryansk region toward Chernihiv region and from Black Sea toward Odesa region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75130, @kpszsu/78901)
Russian forces advanced near Bochkove and Kotlyne in Donetsk region per DeepState map updates. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23841, @DeepStateUA/23844)
Russian strike on electric train in Kharkiv region injured five people, two seriously. (Source: @UkraineNow/84160)
Russian missile hit locomotive of Kyiv-Warsaw train near Polish border; passengers unharmed, Poland scrambled aircraft. (Source: @UkraineNow/84161)
Russian strike on business center in Odesa killed three, one critically; double-tap attack targeted rescuers. (Source: @UkraineNow/84167)
Russian KAB guided bombs struck apartment building in Sumy, possible casualties under rubble. (Source: @UkraineNow/84176)
Ukraine received €3.3 billion EU allocation for drones and missiles; Zelensky confirmed Shahed interceptor jets passed combat tests. (Source: @UkraineNow/84177, @ukr_leaks_eng/33352)

points: Ukrainian air defense engaged massive Russian aerial attack involving ballistic missiles from Chernihiv region and Shahed drones from Bryansk region and Black Sea, with interceptions reported over Kyiv, Chernihiv, Khmelnytskyi, and Odesa regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75117, @mon1tor_ua/75130, @kpszsu/78901, @eRadarrua/114298)

Ukrainian railway operations disrupted: Russian strike on electric train in Kharkiv region injured five passengers, two critically; separate missile hit locomotive of Kyiv-Warsaw express near Polish border, prompting Polish air force scramble. (Source: @UkraineNow/84160, @UkraineNow/84161)

Ukrainian medical evacuation expertise shared with Swedish Armed Forces during September visit, including demonstration of MAUL unmanned ground vehicle for battlefield casualty extraction. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23843)

Ukraine denounced bilateral agreement with Belarus on nuclear accident notification; Lviv mayor reported second discovery of listening device in official vehicle within a year. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33359, @ukr_leaks_eng/33360)

EU allocated additional €3.3 billion to Ukraine for drone and missile procurement; Zelensky announced two domestic interceptor jet systems successfully completed combat trials against Shahed drones. (Source: @UkraineNow/84177, @ukr_leaks_eng/33352)

Ukrainian cyber unit claimed complete destruction of two Mi-8 helicopters, one An-12 and one An-26 transport aircraft at Rostov-Central airport in Russia, awaiting official confirmation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84174)

Ukrainian officials condemned Russian State Duma elections in occupied territories as illegitimate farce; MFA stated voting does not alter international legal status of Ukrainian territories. (Source: @UkraineNow/84164)

Russian President Putin declared Ukraine refuses peace negotiations, accused West of using Ukrainians as "cannon fodder," and claimed Russian defense industry increased missile production 22-fold, radar stations 5-fold, armored vehicles 2.5-fold since war start. (Source: @tass_agency/396095, @tass_agency/396089, @tass_agency/396059)
Russian MFA condemned alleged Ukrainian terrorist attacks against election commission heads in Zaporizhzhia region, calling them unjustifiable. (Source: @tass_agency/396091)

Russian forces launched coordinated ballistic missile strikes from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region and deployed Shahed drones from Bryansk region and Primorsko-Akhtarsk area (~12 groups) against multiple Ukrainian regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75117, @mon1tor_ua/75130, @eRadarrua/114298)

Russian tactical aviation employed guided aerial bombs (KABs) against Sumy region and struck apartment building in Sumy city; separate KAB attack hit business center in Odesa with double-tap on rescuers. (Source: @kpszsu/78879, @UkraineNow/84176, @UkraineNow/84167)
Russian State Duma elections commenced across Russia and occupied Ukrainian regions, with Putin and senior officials voting; turnout reported at 29.45% by 21:00 MSK. (Source: @tass_agency/396078)
Russian air defense ordered by Putin to ensure destruction of all air-space attack means; electronic warfare and interceptor capabilities being prioritized. (Source: @tass_agency/396097)
Russian hybrid threat warning issued by Polish PM Tusk: Russia may launch drone and missile attacks against NATO states supporting Ukraine in coming months. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33349)
Russian ground forces advanced near Bochkove and Kotlyne in Donetsk region, per DeepState map updates on September 18. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23841, @DeepStateUA/23844)
Russian reactive UAVs operating in southern Kharkiv region heading toward Dnipropetrovsk region; reactive UAVs in southern Chernihiv region heading toward Kyiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/78871)
Russian guided aerial bomb strikes conducted by tactical aviation on Sumy region. (Source: @kpszsu/78879)
Russian reactive UAVs detected in Kirovohrad region near Khmelove and Bobrynets on northwesterly course. (Source: @kpszsu/78877)
Russian reactive UAVs launched from Donetsk region toward southern Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @eRadarrua/114305)
Threat of ballistic missile launches from Kursk region reported. (Source: @kpszsu/78864)
Russian forces maintaining pressure along eastern front with combined arms operations including artillery, aviation, and drone strikes. (Source: @kpszsu/78871, @DeepStateUA/23841)

Multiple ballistic missiles launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region, impacting near Boyarka, Brovary, and Vasylkiv districts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75117, @mon1tor_ua/75114, @mon1tor_ua/75115, @mon1tor_ua/75123, @mon1tor_ua/75124, @mon1tor_ua/75129)
Shahed drones entered Chernihiv region from Bryansk region; additional Shaheds over Mykhailivska-Rubezhivka and toward Vasylkiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75130, @mon1tor_ua/75127)
Reactive UAVs detected north of Chernihiv region near Ripky moving southwesterly; reactive UAVs over Brovary heading toward Kyiv. (Source: @kpszsu/78899, @kpszsu/78895)
Russian reconnaissance drones active over Kirovohrad and Poltava regions, likely en route to Kyiv via Cherkasy region. (Source: @eRadarrua/114287)
Ukrainian air defense declared yellow-level drone threat over Kyiv at 20:31, later cleared. (Source: @eRadarrua/114288)
Russian strike on electric train in Kharkiv region injured five, two seriously; passengers stranded on platform during evacuation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84160)
Russian KAB guided bombs struck residential building in Sumy, potential casualties under rubble. (Source: @UkraineNow/84176)
Groups of Russian strike UAVs launched from Black Sea waters toward Pivdenne in Odesa region. (Source: @kpszsu/78901)
Russian UAVs in Kherson region moving toward Arkhanhelske on northwesterly course; reactive UAVs approaching Kherson city from northeast. (Source: @kpszsu/78898, @kpszsu/78900)
Russian UAVs in southern Mykolaiv region heading toward Berezanka. (Source: @kpszsu/78896)
Russian missile strike on business center in Odesa killed three, one critically; double-tap attack targeted first responders. (Source: @UkraineNow/84167)
Russian strike on locomotive of Kyiv-Warsaw train near Polish border (2 km from border), passengers unharmed; Poland scrambled aviation assets. (Source: @UkraineNow/84161)
Russian reactive UAVs operating south of Zaporizhzhia heading west; reactive UAVs east of Kherson heading north. (Source: @kpszsu/78871)
Threat of Shahed-136 drones launched from Primorsko-Akhtarsk area, approximately 12 groups detected. (Source: @eRadarrua/114298)
